en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a two‑story alpine building labeled "CAFFÈ PLANK" in the foreground, with terraces, balconies, and outdoor seating. The house stands among dense coniferous forest, with a footbridge and path leading up to it. Dramatic rocky mountain peaks rise in the background. Printed captions at the top identify the location as S. Martino di Castrozza at 1444 meters and the nearby peak Colbricon at 2604 meters.
